title: OpenMP III: memory ordering, tasks, and trustworthy numerical parallelism
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: Historical lecture timings retained as lecture evidence; absolute values not reproduced on a different laptop.
W4L5 attributes timing differences to program loading; available intervals/builds do not isolate that mechanism.
OpenMP 5.2 HTML dependence page returned 404; authoritative PDF §15.9.5 opened and checked instead.
Indexed SplitMix teaching sequence is deterministic and not proved IID; variance/standard error statements are explicitly ideal IID-model results.
Counter-based Random123 source supports design architecture, not statistical validation of this different SplitMix teaching construction.

lecture_corrections.claim: Flush alone gives every reader the latest value.
lecture_corrections.correction: Visibility must be combined with correctly ordered synchronization; no automatic reader rendezvous.
Bounded n30/cutoff20; slide n5000 is unsuitable. Task-π slide already uses strict upper bounds and disjoint half-open intervals; our independently written code preserves them.
Each second difference needs -2 center coefficient; shown old-array four-neighbor code is Jacobi.
Shown /NR slope over index NR+1 reaches 100.1 for NR1000; canonical code uses book unit-top boundary instead, explicitly disclosed.

lecture_corrections.claim: Physical thread creation/destruction for every region.
lecture_corrections.correction: Region activation and synchronization required; workers may be reused.

lecture_corrections.claim: Reduction gives identical answers and fixes Monte Carlo parallelism.
lecture_corrections.correction: Floating sums can differ in low bits; RNG hidden state/stream mapping are separate.
Visible update traverses N rows, copy traverses N+2; inner count K[N+(N+2)], outer2K. ForK=N1000,2,002,000 versus2000.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §1.4.1
references.supports: Temporary views, unordered conflicting accesses, shared-storage lifetimes.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §1.4.4
references.supports: Strong flush set, visibility and reordering; separate synchronization order.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §1.4.6
references.supports: Race-free ordinary synchronized programs need no extra explicit flush.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §5.1.1
references.supports: Task defaults and loop/local variable ownership rules.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §5.4.4
references.supports: firstprivate initialization at encounter; a pointer copy is not a deep copy.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §11.1
references.supports: Single selects a team thread, not necessarily primary, and has implicit ending barrier without nowait.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §12.5
references.supports: Explicit task creation and immediate/deferred team execution; shared lifetime obligation.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 §15.5
references.supports: Plain taskwait waits prior immediate children, not arbitrary descendants.

references.title: OpenMP 5.2 PDF §15.9.5
references.supports: Sibling task dependence storage matching and access synchronization.

references.title: Netlib Templates, Jacobi
references.supports: Jacobi independent simultaneous old-iterate updates use auxiliary storage.

references.title: Linux manual rand(3)
references.supports: Seeded sequence and hidden generator state; Linux documented MT-Safe does not imply independent scalable streams.

references.title: Salmon et al. 2011, Parallel Random Numbers: As Easy as 1, 2, 3
references.supports: Counter/key transformation design for parallel generation; not evidence for our different generator.

references.title: Vigna, SplitMix source
references.supports: Public-domain increment and mixing operations adapted to direct indexed evaluation.
